title: Various Trade Agreements
definition: Trade agreements are legally binding pacts between two or more nations designed to facilitate commerce, eliminate tariffs, reduce non-tariff barriers, and govern cross-border investments and economic cooperation.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (factual questions on FTAs, PTAs, CEPAs, rules of origin, and multilateral bodies like WTO) and Mains GS-3 (Indian Economy, bilateral/regional groupings, and impacts on domestic manufacturing and exports).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Various Trade Agreements.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of International Trade and Balance of Payments
